'''Florian Święs''' ({{IPA|pl|flɔ.rjan ɕfjɛw̃s}}; born 24 September 1939) is a Polish biologist. He is a full professor of Biology and Earth Sciences at the [[Maria Curie-Skłodowska University]]. In 1992 he became the Head of the Geobiology Division at the Institute of Biology.

He received his [[Master of Arts|MA]] from [[UMCS]] in 1962, his [[Ph.D.]] in 1968, and became a [[professor]] in 1992.
